data.title: 埃塔 · 新药调配与紫色烟雾
data.description: 埃塔系着皮围裙守在坩埚前，紫色的烟雾正咕嘟咕嘟地冒出来。她面无表情地往锅里又加了一味材料——至于喝的人是谁，那是下一个问题。
data.location: alchemy corner of a laboratory with a bubbling cauldron, herb bundles and rows of vials
data.action: adding an ingredient to a bubbling cauldron with purple smoke, leather apron, completely deadpan expression
data.lighting: 坩埚火焰与紫色烟雾的映光
data.promptProse: Purple smoke, deadpan face, one more ingredient. Eta's newest potion is ready — the taster is tomorrow's problem.
data.animaCaption: The potion is finished. Finding a volunteer is, as always, the hardest step.
